candidate.title: HTGTS
candidate.scope: The separately labeled HTGTS row assigned by the HTGTS card: the sonication/end-repair/3′-A-addition/adapter-PCR route ending in purified DNA. Hu et al. Figure 1a supports this Illumina implementation; this is not a claim that all historical HTGTS preparations follow it. The complete image also contains an independently labeled LAM-HTGTS row, a partial Break-seq row and SELEX-family material. They are neighboring catalogue entries, with no branch or alternative connector admitting them into this card. The candidate collection page has an HTGTS heading but captions its similar drawing HTGTS-Rep-seq; that unshown adaptation does not add another target. Sequencing is described as interpretation of the terminal library, not an extra drawn operation.

states.label: Purified HTGTS DNA library
features: Terminal product labeled DNA. The sequenced insert is the physical carrier of bait–prey junction information.

The known bait and captured genomic prey are associated on a junction-bearing molecule. Sequence-based interpretation identifies sequences joined to the bait and their junction structure, rather than directly counting all unjoined DSB ends.

Local breaksite resection and background products can occur; each product is not automatically a unique distal translocation. These related assays cannot readily give absolute cutting rates because uncut and perfectly rejoined bait sequences can be indistinguishable.

method_scopes.rationale: The assigned card title and separately labeled HTGTS row restrict this extraction to the eight h_* operations. The prior inclusion of the adjacent LAM-HTGTS graph is removed: row proximity and Hu’s scientific comparison do not establish a grouped card or depicted alternative. The retained history is sonication, end repair, 3′ A addition, combined adapter ligation/PCR, streptavidin capture, nested PCR, tagged PCR and purification. Hu Figure 1a supports this implementation; Chiarle supports the underlying bait–prey junction principle without establishing identical preparation chemistry. The poster’s Linear amplification-mediated expansion is resolved explicitly in correction_htgts_expansion. No LAM-PCR, bridge ligation or enzyme blocking is inserted into this HTGTS row.
